title: Ownership Structure Candidates Schema
description: Schema for ownership structure chart candidates with appropriate reasons.

extracted_records.description: Organization and individual candidates to build ownership structure chart.

id.description: Sequential integer, 1-based, in document reading order.

itemType.description: Natural Person for a natural person; Non Natural Person for any legal entity or arrangement (company, fund, trust, foundation, partnership, government body).

layer.description: Ownership layer relative to the client: 0 = client, 1 = direct owner of the client, 2 = owner of a layer-1 entity, etc.

relationshipType.description: Documented relationship of this record to its linkedName parent. Null for the client (layer 0).

roleCapacity.description: Classification outcome under applicable global/local rules and evidence.

documentName.description: Name of the document from which this record was extracted.

sourceClass.description: Evidence strength of the controlling source (H1 primary, H2 supporting legal/constitutional, H3 supplementary).

evidenceSnippet.description: Verbatim quote from the source document evidencing this link/percentage/direction. Null only when no textual evidence exists (record the gap in outOfBounds).

isUltimateParent.description: True if this record is the ultimate parent of the ownership structure.

isIBO.description: IBO is true if an IBO of the organisation else false.

isUBO.description: UBO is true if an UBO of the organisation else false.

actualOwnershipPercentage.description: Actual ownership percentage of the individual or organization in the entity.

actualVotingRightsPercentage.description: Voting rights percentage of the individual or organization in the entity.

dominationOwnership.description: Domination ownership of the individual or organization in the entity. Numeric percentage only.

dominationVotingRights.description: Domination voting rights of the individual or organization in the entity. Numeric percentage only.

dominationIndicator.description: Whether domination/control is evidenced for this record (§10). Null when not assessed.

controlRights.description: Documented control rights (board appointment, veto, GP/managing-member control, shareholder-agreement control, etc.); null if none.

ownershipVotingMismatch.description: True when economic ownership and voting rights diverge for this record (§10).

controlBasedUBOAssessmentRequired.description: True when control evidence requires a control-based UBO assessment (§10/§12).

conflictTag.description: Provide if conflict detected. C: clear = no conflict detected. C: resolved = conflict detected but resolved. C: unresolved = conflict detected but not resolved.

listingProof.description: Listing evidence when this record is a listed entity; null otherwise (prompt §11.2).

localOverlayApplied.description: True when a Local Addendum overlay was applied to this record (§7/§13).

thresholdApplied.description: The ownership threshold applied for classification (e.g. '25% or more', '10%'); null if none.

inclusiveThreshold.description: True when the applied threshold is inclusive ('equal to or more than', §13.1).

drillDownRequired.description: True when local rules require drill-down beyond an otherwise-permitted stop (§13.3).

governanceBasis.description: The ownership reasoning for this record as a single structured string covering the eight aspects of rule 18: [0] narrative explanation, [1] ownership basis, [2] source basis, [3] entity scope, [4] local/global rule interpretation, [5] currency/quality, [6] conflict/gap/outbound analysis, [7] final decision summary.

coverageMode.description: Coverage mode. ALL = all individuals/organisations emitted regardless of currency. Always ALL in current pipeline.

controlsApplied.description: Control rules checked or applied for this candidate. Include rules checked or triggered. Omit rules structurally irrelevant to this candidate's entity type or country.

qaFlags.description: QA annotation flags for downstream audit and review. Each entry is a free-text flag from QA rules. Empty array when no issues detected.

outOfBounds.description: Out-of-bounds assessment derived from ownership results.

isOutOfBounds.description: True if this individual or organization is determined to be out of bounds for ownership candidacy based on ownership results.

reason.description: Canonical reason for OOB flag. Null when isOutOfBounds is false.

status.description: OOB status category. Set to null when isOutOfBounds is false.

outOfBounds.description: A summary and list of records that were identified but fall outside the defined scope of an Ownership Structure.

summary.description: Start with the documentName and then give an overall summary of the out-of-bounds records (avoid count of records) including firstName, lastName or legalName (if available), documentName (mention the documentName in this summary), reason (if applicable) including the status.

documents.description: A list of documents that were identified but fall outside the defined scope of an Ownership Structure.

reason.description: A clear explanation of why this file record is considered out of bounds.

status.description: The status of the reason, indicating DOC_INVALID or DOCUMENT_NOT_RELEVANT.

records.description: A list of items that were identified but fall outside the defined scope of an Ownership Structure.

id.description: A unique, auto-generated incremental ID for this record.

reason.description: A clear explanation of why this record is considered out of bounds.

status.description: The status of the reason, indicating NEED_REVIEW or COUNTRY_OUT_OF_SCOPE.

qaFlags.description: A summary and set of quality assurance and inference flags based on the document analysis.

summary.description: Start with the documentName and then give an overall summary of the qa_flags records.

records.description: A list of quality assurance and inference flag reasons based on the document analysis.

reason.description: A clear explanation of why this reason has quality assurance and inference flags.

status.description: The status of the record, per rule 16 QA Flag statuses: CONFIDENT, NOT_CONFIDENT, NEED_REVIEW, or DOC_INVALID.

outbound.description: Case-level outbound requests for missing information (prompt §15). Distinct from outOfBounds (scope exclusion).
